report.success_criterion: On the unmodified buggy commit 692289e4, the selected tests fail (at least one assertion failure and the ValueError: Input contains NaN); the same selector passes (all green) once the PR #30514 fix is applied. The bug is considered reproduced when test_isotonic_outofbounds errors and the stress-monotonicity/normalized-stress assertions fail.

examples.expected_output: No error; smacof(dis, init=init, metric=False, n_init=1) returns normally (fixed via out_of_bounds='clip')
examples.buggy_output_reported: Raises ValueError: Input contains NaN (IsotonicRegression out-of-bounds on the 6.661338147750939e-16 dissimilarity)

examples.input: sim = [[0,5,3,4],[5,0,2,2],[3,2,0,1],[4,2,1,0]]; Z = [[-0.266,-0.539],[0.451,0.252],[0.016,-0.238],[-0.200,0.524]]; stress1 from mds.smacof(sim, init=Z, n_components=2, max_iter=1000, n_init=1, normalized_stress=True); stress2 from same call with metric=False
examples.expected_output: stress1 > stress2 (non-metric stress strictly lower than metric stress)
examples.buggy_output_reported: assert stress1 > stress2 fails: broken non-metric MDS yields stress2 >= stress1 (loss increases)

examples.input: digits subset X = load_digits() X[rng.choice(len(X), size=200, replace=False)] with rng = np.random.default_rng(seed=42); MDS(n_components=2, n_init=1, eps=1e-15, max_iter=2, metric=False, random_state=42).fit(X).stress_ vs same with max_iter=3
examples.expected_output: stress_after_2_iter > stress_after_3_iter (stress decreases with more iterations)
examples.buggy_output_reported: assert stress_after_2_iter > stress_after_3_iter fails: stress does not decrease (loss increases/stops)

examples.input: X = np.array([[1, 1], [1, 4], [1, 5], [3, 3]]); MDS(n_components=2, n_init=1, eps=1e-15, max_iter=1000, metric=False, random_state=42).fit(X).stress_
examples.expected_output: stress == 0 within atol=1e-10 (MDS recovers the true data)
examples.buggy_output_reported: stress is not ~0; assert_allclose(stress, 0, atol=1e-10) fails for metric=False
